example_sentences_in_bangla: ষড়রিপু জয় করতে হলে আত্মানুসন্ধান করতে হয়।

history: Derived from ancient Hindu scriptures like the Bhagavad Gita, representing internal vices that hinder spiritual progress.
note: This idiom is deeply embedded in Indian philosophical traditions, commonly used in Bengali literature and discourse on morality.
